patch.value: Bisect stable changes using a linked pm test command
Add pm vcs bisect driven by pm test <id> --run, persisting change-id results across history rewrites and restoring the original working state.

Good/bad boundaries identify the first failing stable change using the linked real pm test; rewritten commit ids reuse change results; interrupted/failed tests and conflicted candidates have explicit outcomes; TOON and JSON report the result and original state is restored.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Plan for bisect: single command 'pm vcs bisect' with start|good|bad|skip|run|status|reset subcommands. Durable session state lives in the worktree's private control directory (atomic write) so a crash mid-walk leaves a resumable session; session milestones (start, conclusion, reset) are appended to PM history as comments on the linked item, so concurrent agents see each other's sessions and append-only history is never clobbered. Candidates are ordered oldest-first by ancestry; outcomes are keyed by stable change identity so rewritten commit ids (rebase/amend/describe) reuse recorded results. Linked test execution reuses the pm SDK runTest (pm test --run semantics). Outcomes: good, bad, skip (manual), untestable (spawn/timeout/signal/empty), conflicted (candidate carries unresolved conflict units). Original branch and commit are restored after success, refusal, SIGINT and crash-resume.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Resuming the interrupted implementation as codex-agent. Reviewing durable state, linked-test semantics, restore safety, candidate ordering and cross-agent history before completing real-repository proofs and unchanged release gates. Existing uncommitted work is preserved.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Review fixes: execute each candidate in a disposable native repository so tracked PM history and original checkout bytes survive test side effects, SIGINT and SIGKILL. Rebased results now map stable identities to current ancestry. Exit 125 is skip; unresolved potential culprits produce ambiguous rather than a false first_bad. Per-worktree process leases prevent concurrent local mutation; separate linked instances append start/step/halt/done/reset receipts to the shared tracker. The annotate refactor shares immutable historical harness/model provenance with the bisect report.

value.text: Behavioral revert proof: disabling only selectBisectCandidate (returning no candidate) made both the 64-change history and rewritten-history regressions fail (0 passed, 2 failed). Restored the production function immediately. Added explicit candidate-log budget/omission reporting because the pinned PM host rejects universal read-output controls for the mixed bisect command. Long comments must be verified through full item reads; the SDK comments response abbreviates them. Public-data demo uses a locally trusted linked test, not a command inherited from a foreign Git ref.
